description: Canvas redesign + Panel restyle + Toolbar restyle: Replace all Material-blue hardcoded colors with design system CSS variables across canvas layers, panels, and toolbar
steps: 1. CANVAS - GridLayer (frontend/src/canvas/layers/GridLayer.tsx): Replace '#c0c0c0' and '#e0e0e0' with a warm subtle grid color. Use rgba version of hairline color at 0.3 opacity. Since Konva stroke doesn't support CSS vars, use the literal values from the design system: stroke for minor lines = 'rgba(227, 225, 221, 0.3)' (hairline at 0.3 opacity), stroke for major lines = 'rgba(227, 225, 221, 0.6)' (hairline at 0.6 opacity for distinction). Comment the source variable name.
2. CANVAS - WallOutlineLayer (frontend/src/canvas/layers/WallOutlineLayer.tsx): Replace '#000000' stroke with '#1A1A1A' (ink color). Add comment referencing --color-ink-primary.

3. CANVAS - ZonesLayer (frontend/src/canvas/layers/ZonesLayer.tsx): Replace all Material-blue colors. Default zone: stroke '#6E6E6E' (secondary) at 1px strokeWidth. Selected zone: stroke '#9A7B4F' (accent) at 1.5px. Highlighted zone: keep '#ffc107' or change to accent. Error zone: '#B0413E' (error). Fill colors: default = 'rgba(246, 245, 243, 0.5)' (warm canvas tint), selected = 'rgba(154, 123, 79, 0.08)' (accent at 8%), highlighted = 'rgba(154, 123, 79, 0.12)'. Error fill = 'rgba(176, 65, 62, 0.04)'. Zone label fill: '#1A1A1A'. Teal system-generated color '#4db6ac' -> '#6E6E6E' (secondary).

4. CANVAS - SelectionLayer (frontend/src/canvas/layers/SelectionLayer.tsx): Replace '#1976d2' with '#9A7B4F' (accent) for selection outlines and bounding box. Marquee fill: 'rgba(154, 123, 79, 0.08)', marquee stroke: '#9A7B4F'.

5. CANVAS - CanvasContainer (frontend/src/canvas/CanvasContainer.tsx): The container div currently has no explicit background. Add backgroundColor using the warm canvas color. Since it's in a style prop, set backgroundColor: '#F6F5F3'. Comment referencing --color-canvas.

6. TOOLBAR - Toolbar.tsx (frontend/src/components/Toolbar.tsx): Replace ALL inline styles with design system values. Specifically: toolbar bg '#fafafa' -> '#FFFFFF' (surface). Border bottom '#e0e0e0' -> '1px solid #E3E1DD' (hairline). Mode badge: replace blue/orange with accent pill (bg: 'rgba(154, 123, 79, 0.12)', color: '#9A7B4F' for both modes). Container height should be 40px (add height: '40px' to container style, adjust padding). Publish button bg '#7b1fa2' -> '#9A7B4F' (accent). Save status colors: saving '#ff9800' -> '#A66A2D' (warning), saved '#4caf50' -> '#3F6B4F' (success), unsaved/error '#f44336' -> '#B0413E' (error). Finalized badge: use success color scheme (#3F6B4F text, light green bg).

7. WALL CONFIG PANEL - WallConfigPanel.tsx (frontend/src/components/WallConfigPanel.tsx): Replace all inline styles. Panel: width '320px', padding using space-4 value '16px', borderLeft '1px solid #E3E1DD', bg '#FFFFFF'. Section headers <h4>: fontSize '12px', fontWeight 600, color '#6E6E6E', textTransform uppercase (keep existing pattern but ensure color). Labels: fontSize '13px', color '#6E6E6E'. Inputs: height '32px' (use padding to achieve), borderRadius '4px', border '1px solid #D8D5D0', bg '#FFFFFF'. Read-only inputs: bg '#F6F5F3'. Focus state: add CSS class for focus (will be in components.css). Buttons: primary = bg '#9A7B4F' + color '#FFFFFF', secondary = border '1px solid #D8D5D0' + bg transparent. Error box: border '#B0413E', bg 'rgba(176, 65, 62, 0.06)', color '#B0413E'. Success box (frame count): border '1px solid #3F6B4F', bg 'rgba(63, 107, 79, 0.06)', color '#3F6B4F'. Remove buttons in lighting/furniture: border '#B0413E', bg 'rgba(176, 65, 62, 0.06)', color '#B0413E'.

8. MEASUREMENT PANEL - MeasurementPanel.tsx (frontend/src/components/MeasurementPanel.tsx): Same pattern as WallConfigPanel. Width '320px', borderLeft '1px solid #E3E1DD', bg '#FFFFFF'. Labels '13px' '#6E6E6E'. Inputs: height '32px', border '1px solid #D8D5D0', borderRadius '4px'. Error text: '#B0413E'. Hint text: '#6E6E6E'. Lock icon color: '#D8D5D0'. Panel title: fontSize '14px', fontWeight 600, color '#1A1A1A'.
acceptance_criteria: No Material Design blue (#1976d2, #bbdefb, #e3f2fd, #4db6ac) colors remain in any canvas layer or panel file
Grid lines use hairline color at 0.3 opacity (very subtle)
Zone default outline is #6E6E6E, selected is #9A7B4F at 1.5px
Selection handles and marquee use accent color #9A7B4F
WallConfigPanel width is 320px with left hairline border
MeasurementPanel width is 320px with left hairline border
Toolbar height is 40px with white bg and bottom hairline border
Mode badge uses accent color (not blue/orange)
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run
findings: All 1094 tests pass. Build succeeds. Typecheck passes (only pre-existing TS6133 unused var in ValidationOverlayLayer.tsx). Updated ZonesLayer.validation.test.tsx assertions to match new error color #B0413E. All Material Design blue colors eliminated from canvas layers, toolbar, and panels. No business logic changed.
